# CrossDomainGeneralization

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The ability of a model trained on one or more source domains to perform well on unseen target domains without retraining. Key for scalable TCC/iNEST solutions that must operate across diverse optical network topologies without per-domain tuning.
